integrity: Analytical global inequality and equality classification, supplemented by a reproducible exact symbolic computation and independent finite numerical checks; numerical tests are not used as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats polynomial degrees zero through two in the normalized-area unit disk. It neither bounds arbitrary degrees nor proves an unrestricted Bergman embedding. No independent novelty or proof audit has been performed; priority can be affected by equivalent older Nikolskii identities.
title: Sharp quartic Bergman norm through polynomial degree two and its first truncated-kernel obstruction
